findings.summary: control image did not prove the fixed gh-webhook extension was executable
findings.evidence: pinned per-architecture checksums and build-time gh webhook --help

findings.summary: supervisor did not stop every component on all actual-state persistence failures
findings.evidence: all reconciliation write failures invoke stopAll

findings.summary: fixed provider examples contain sample-domain identities
findings.evidence: Issue #13 requires the fixed contract-v1.0.0-rc.1 provider input byte-for-byte; exact trust anchoring was separately confirmed and fixed as CISO03-R2-CX-003

findings.summary: status omitted recent job and delivery failure identities
findings.evidence: repeatable-read projections include lastJobFailure and recentDeliveryFailures

findings.summary: execution-disabled monitors skipped observation behavior
findings.evidence: polls observe without enqueueing or advancing cursors

findings.summary: check and push events were acknowledged without typed durable work
findings.evidence: check_run, check_suite, and push produce validated WorkItems

findings.summary: rejected retry outcomes lacked durable attempt and replay audit identity
findings.evidence: accepted and rejected retry attempts and idempotent responses are transactional

findings.summary: same-key webhook and poll enqueue could race into repository single-flight conflict
findings.evidence: same length-framed advisory lock key serializes both Go and TypeScript adapters

findings.summary: forwarder child inherited unrelated control-plane secrets
findings.evidence: child environment is an explicit GitHub/network/locale allowlist

findings.summary: repository-busy monitor handling could churn and advance state incorrectly
findings.evidence: busy is projected as running backpressure and cursor remains unchanged

findings.summary: dedup compared decoded JSON numbers instead of PostgreSQL jsonb value equality
findings.evidence: delivery and job equality checks use jsonb equality

findings.summary: retry scheduling mixed application and PostgreSQL clocks
findings.evidence: retry deadlines are derived from clock_timestamp

findings.summary: push identity aliased the same commit across branches
findings.evidence: length-framed canonical ref plus after SHA and distinct-branch regression

findings.summary: Registration version rejection could become an unrecoverable dedup tombstone
findings.evidence: stale-only rejected observations are atomically rebound, requeued, and audited under the current version in both adapters

findings.summary: Experience gate accepted a self-consistent replacement bundle
findings.evidence: compiled exact approved bundleDigest trust anchor and fully rebound semantic-tamper negative test

findings.summary: forwarder heartbeat write failure left the child running
findings.evidence: heartbeat error races process output, cancels the child, and exits the supervised slot

findings.summary: accepted retry had no queryable current delivery state
findings.evidence: authenticated GET /v1/deliveries/{deliveryId} returns the current delivery and durable retry-attempt history

findings.summary: TypeScript and JSON Registration contracts allowed configuration rejected by Go
findings.evidence: strict empty-object Zod, maxProperties zero JSON Schema, SQL CHECK, and cross-language regressions

findings.summary: two dead helpers remained
findings.evidence: helpers removed

findings.summary: projection staleness mixed application and database clocks
findings.evidence: one PostgreSQL clock_timestamp value drives the repeatable-read projection

findings.summary: control image did not explicitly set HOME
findings.evidence: HOME=/home/agentops is fixed in the control image
